title: EngineContract
description: The engine's calls (native/engine/src/call.rs): for each name, the JSON input it takes and the JSON answer it gives. The one source of their shapes: web/src/lib/engine/contract.ts is generated from it (npm run types), and native/engine/tests/contract.rs holds the engine's answers to it. A member left out of `required` may be missing; a type with null may be null.

holding.description: The planner's /api/holding answer (AIM 5-3-8): the entry and its steps, the other entry near a sector's edge, and the legs in the wind where a true airspeed, wind and altitude are all given.

heading.description: The airplane's heading to the fix, degrees.

altitude_ft.description: MSL; none is taken as at or below 14,000 ft.

holding_leg_minutes.description: The inbound leg's minutes (AIM 5-3-8 j.4(a)): 1 at or below 14,000 ft MSL, 1.5 above.

lost_comms.description: The planner's /api/lost-comms answer (14 CFR 91.185): VFR's words, the routes in the rule's order (c)(1), each segment's altitude (c)(2) and when to leave the clearance limit (c)(3).

expected_from.description: The index of the segment from which the expected altitude applies, a whole number; 0 where left out.

diversion.description: The planner's /api/diversion solved, steps, problem and checks (ACS PA.VI.C): the diversion worked out in the leg's own air, and the student's estimates checked against it.

to.description: The field's ident, for the problem's words.

wind_triangle.description: The wind triangle for a true course: the correction (+ right), the true heading and the ground speed; null where no heading holds the course.

diversion_reasonable.description: Whether a student's estimate is within the diversion drill's allowance (ACS PA.VI.C.S2); an error for a key not estimated.

debrief.description: The planner's /api/debrief answer (ACS PA.VI.A): the flight flown against the plan, each finding marked, and the tolerances it is held to.

anyOf.description: Each field's pattern altitude, ft MSL, by ident.

debrief_airborne.description: The track's flights as [first, last] point indices.

checklist_read.description: A checklist typed as text read into the gateway's ChecklistDto.

checklist_write.description: A checklist written as text again: each section its "# title" line and its items, "challenge -- response".

csv_rows.description: A CSV file's rows of fields.

logbook_csv_read.description: A logbook CSV (ForeFlight's export or this logbook's own) read into the gateway's LogbookEntryRequest entries, camelCase, and the lines skipped with why; landings as 14 CFR 61.57(a) and (b) count them.

logbook_csv_write.description: The logbook as a CSV file in ForeFlight's column names, oldest flight first.

handbook_figures.description: A handbook specifications page's figures, read from the text off its photo; a figure not found is left out.

endorsement_lapse.description: The warning an instructor sees once their date has passed on the day of signing (14 CFR 61.197(a), (e)), or null.

until_kind.description: "EXP" for the certificate's expiry; anything else is recent experience ("RE").

endorsements_in_force.description: The latest not voided of each code, as [code, index] into the record (newest first).

endorsement_render.description: An endorsement's words as they will be signed.

acs_codes.description: The ACS codes in pasted text, each once.

read_clearance.description: An ATC clearance heard, read into its items as the web's lib/clearance read it (AIM 4-4-3), camelCase.

read_atis.description: An ATIS or AWOS/ASOS broadcast heard, read into its figures (AIM 4-1-13); a figure not heard is null.

cleared_route.description: The route a clearance gives, from the words heard, the planner's places found for them (ClearancePlaces) and the route planned.

our_call.description: Whether a transmission is said to the airplane `tail` (AIM 4-2-4).

direct_of.description: The place a "direct" sends us to, as words to find, or null.

call_pattern.description: Our call sign as a regular expression over a recognizer's words (AIM 4-2-4), for a locked phone's listener; null where `tail` is no registration.

tokens.description: The words heard with each run of figures one number (AIM 4-2-8, 4-2-9).

place_words.description: Words for a place as the planner looks them up, the ICAO alphabet's spelled (AIM 4-2-7).

readback_check.description: A readback against the clearance heard (AIM 4-4-7): what was missed or said otherwise, and the warning line.

magnetic_variation.description: Magnetic variation, degrees east (west negative), the World Magnetic Model's (WMM) at a place and day, as wingtip.magnetic works it out.

data_cycle.description: Whether an FAA data set's edition is in force on a day, by its cycle: AIRAC's 28 days (NASR, CIFP, d-TPP), the 56-day charting cycle (sectional, terminal area and IFR enroute charts, the Chart Supplement) or the Digital Obstacle File's 56-day releases, from the FAA's 28 and 56 Day Product Schedule and its DOF page.

kind.description: The schedule the data set is published on.

effective.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date the edition held is named by (its effective date; a DOF file's last day of changes). Missing or null where nothing says.

on.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the UTC day it is used on.

current.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the edition in force on `on` took effect (a DOF's release).

current_ident.description: The AIRAC cycle's number, YYNN ("2611"); null off AIRAC.

next.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the next edition takes its place.

effective.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day the edition held counts from; null where unknown.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the first day the edition held no longer counts; null where unknown.

behind.description: How many editions have come out since the one held; 0 unless expired.

airspace_column.description: The airspace over a point in bands, from the ground to FL600 (14 CFR 71.33, 71.71): a B, C or D where it is drawn, the most restrictive where they overlap, E from its floor or 14,500 ft, G under it all, A from 18,000 ft, split where 91.155's minimums, 91.117's speed or 91.215's transponder rule changes. The volumes are the caller's, read from the NASR shapefile or a cycle pack.

in_veil.description: Inside a 30 nm Mode C veil (91.215(b)(2)).

mode_c_veil.description: The nearest Mode C veil airport (14 CFR part 91 appendix D section 1) within 30 nm of a point (91.215(b)(2), 91.225(d)(2)), the distance to a tenth; null outside every veil. An airport with no place is passed over.

notams_fns.description: The NOTAMs of one FAA NOTAM System (FNS) message, AIXM 5.1, as wingtip.notams keeps them: each by its domestic place and number, else its place and ICAO number; `ends` the sooner of its own end and its feature lifetime's. None where the message is not XML.

notam_text.description: A NOTAM's number, place and times from its text as sent, the domestic form (FAA JO 7930.2) or the ICAO one (Annex 15), as a list of one; null where it is neither.

metar_read.description: A METAR or SPECI as sent, read into the planner's metar dict (AC 00-45H); null where the station and time cannot be read.

taf_read.description: A TAF as sent, read into the planner's TAF dict (AC 00-45H), its day-and-hour times placed nearest `near` (Unix seconds); null where it cannot be read.

winds_read.description: The winds and temperatures aloft forecast (FB) as sent, read into the planner's stations and its FOR USE window (AC 00-45H), its days placed by `now` (Unix seconds); null where it cannot be read.

tfr_detail_read.description: A TFR's detail from the FAA's TFR XML: its NOTAM, times, altitudes and areas; null where it holds no NOTAM. Not XML is refused.

ceiling_ft.description: A report's ceiling, ft above the ground: the lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer (14 CFR 1.1), an obscured sky's at its vertical visibility; null where there is none or it is not known (sky_ceiling tells them apart).

sky_ceiling.description: A report's ceiling as ceiling_ft finds it, and whether it is not known: the lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer sent with no height ("OVC///", the AWC's layer with no base) leaves it unknown, not absent (14 CFR 1.1).

report_flight_category.description: A report's flight category (AC 00-45H, AIM 7-1-7): LIFR under 500 ft or a mile, IFR under 1,000 ft or 3, MVFR to 3,000 ft or 5, else VFR, a missing figure no limit; null where neither is given; with ceiling_unknown (a ceiling reported with no height) LIFR under a mile's visibility, else null.

vfr_basic_minimums.description: The least any VFR minimums come to (14 CFR 91.155(c), (d)): no VFR under a 1,000 ft ceiling or in under 3 statute miles in a surface area.

reserve_min.description: The fuel reserve in minutes at normal cruise: 30 by day and 45 at night under VFR (14 CFR 91.151(a)), 45 under IFR (91.167(a)(3)).

isa_temp_c.description: A standard day's temperature at a pressure altitude (ICAO Doc 7488).

density_ratio.description: Sigma, the air's density at a pressure altitude and temperature over a standard day's at sea level (ICAO Doc 7488).

density_altitude_ft.description: The altitude at which a standard day's air has density sigma.

pressure_altitude_ft.description: Pressure altitude from a field's elevation and its altimeter setting, a thousand feet an inch from 29.92 (PHAK ch. 4).

is_eastbound.description: Whether a magnetic course is eastbound, 0 to 179 degrees (14 CFR 91.159(a)).

lowest_vfr_cruising_altitude.description: The lowest VFR cruising altitude at or above a floor for a magnetic course: odd thousands plus 500 eastbound, even westbound (14 CFR 91.159(a)).

distance_nm.description: The geodesic distance between two points on the WGS 84 ellipsoid, nm.

region_of.description: The phone pack's region holding a point, "n40w088": a square of 4 degrees named by its south-west corner.

descent_ft_per_nm.description: The planned descent: 1,000 ft for every 3 nm, about a 3 degree path (AIM 2-1-2), feet a nautical mile.

words_num.description: A number as JavaScript writes it into a string, "null" for none.

words_one.description: A number to a tenth, JavaScript's Math.round(n * 10) / 10.

words_to_fixed.description: JavaScript's toFixed: the nearest, a tie to the larger magnitude, on the float's exact value.

words_grouped.description: A whole number with a comma between each three figures, "12,500" (lib/units grouped).

words_alt_ft.description: An altitude grouped, "12,500"; an em dash for none (lib/units altFt).

words_flight_level.description: A cruising altitude in hundreds of feet, "FL-045"; "FL-___" for none (lib/units flightLevel).

words_ceiling_and_visibility.description: Ceiling and visibility as a briefer says them, "3,500 ft · 6 sm", "no ceiling · —".

gonogo_hazard_window.description: Whether a flight in a hazard from `enter` to `leave` is there while it is valid: "before" it starts, "after" it ends, else "during", its window widened by `margin_min` either way (30, PASS_MARGIN_MIN, where missing: an ETA is an estimate); null where it gives no window.

weather_expires_at.description: When a weather report stops counting, Unix seconds UTC, or null where nothing says: a routine METAR an hour after it was observed (AIM 7-1-28, "METAR-hourly"; FMH-1 ch. 2), a SPECI when the next routine report is due, a TAF, the FB winds or an advisory at the end of the valid time its header gives (AC 00-45H).

observed.description: When a METAR or SPECI was observed, Unix seconds.

last_routine.description: For a SPECI, the last routine report's time, Unix seconds, where it is known.

valid_to.description: For a forecast, the end of its valid time (the FB winds' FOR USE window), Unix seconds.

weather_in_force.description: Whether a weather report still counts at now: before it expires (weather_expires_at), and, for a forecast, from when its valid time starts, since a TAF's later hours are not today's weather (AC 00-45H).

now.description: The instant asked about, Unix seconds.

observed.description: When a METAR or SPECI was observed, Unix seconds.

last_routine.description: For a SPECI, the last routine report's time, Unix seconds, where it is known.

valid_from.description: For a forecast, the start of its valid time, Unix seconds.

valid_to.description: For a forecast, the end of its valid time, Unix seconds.

gonogo_verdict.description: POST /api/go-no-go's line and items: each tab's finding, the IFR alternate's in the weather's (14 CFR 91.169), and the line over them. The findings are the planner's; the decision is the pilot in command's (14 CFR 91.3).

alternate.description: /api/alternate's answer; null or left out under VFR.

gonogo_verdict_items.description: Each tab's finding, in the order a pilot goes through them (AIM 7-1-5(b)), each with where it is shown in full.

gonogo_verdict_line.description: What the findings come to, in a line over them: the worst finding and the tabs that have it.

gonogo_alternate_finding.description: What the IFR alternate comes to for the Go / No-Go (14 CFR 91.169(a)(2), (b)): a stop where the one filed will not do, a caution where one is needed and none is filed or it is the pilot's to check; null where none is needed.

gonogo_with_alternate.description: The items with the alternate's finding put in the weather's, where the weather says nothing worse.

gonogo_under_minimums.description: The sentences where the weather is under the pilot's own minimums, at each field landed at and the destination's forecast.

landings.description: The fields landed at, by ident.

metars.description: The briefing's METARs by field ident; null or missing for none.

airports.description: The briefing's airports by field ident, each with its runways.

forecast.description: The briefing's forecast along the route.

gonogo_best_crosswind.description: The least crosswind of the open runways' (gusts' where more), or the whole reported wind where no runway has components; null with none.

closed.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_icing.description: Icing possible at an altitude flown, under IFR: the highest altitude at or above the freezing level, with its line; null where the flight is not planned into it.

icing_possible.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

freezing_level_at_or_below.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

reports.description: Pilot reports of icing near the route, NEG not counted.

at_or_below.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_risk.description: The risk assessment (PAVE, IMSAFE): its points, level, line, what to do, and every factor marked.

vfr_not_recommended.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

tfr_on_route.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

hazards.description: The number of SIGMETs and G-AIRMETs on the route.

night.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

ifr.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

within_limit.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

vor_check.description: The VOR check (14 CFR 91.171): left out for a stock profile, null for none recorded.

inoperative.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

ticked.description: The self checks ticked, by key, true where ticked.

words.description: What to do at this level.

gonogo_inspection_factors.description: The airplane's recorded inspections past their day, as factors: annual (14 CFR 91.409(a)), ELT (91.207(c), (d)), altimeter and static (91.411(a)), transponder (91.413(a)), 100-hour (91.409(b)).

ifr.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_squawk_factors.description: The airplane's open squawks as risk factors.

inoperative.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

night.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

ifr.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_self_checks.description: The self checks the Brief's Risk page lists (IMSAFE and PAVE), in order, with no mark.

gonogo_risk_line.description: An assessment in a few words: "Raised · 8 points".

gonogo_short_field.description: The POH's short-field distances at a pressure altitude, temperature, weight and headwind (14 CFR 91.103(b)).

grass.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_end_distance.description: The distances on a runway and whether they are over its length.

caveats.description: What could not be had from the table: beyond its altitudes or temperatures, heavier than its heaviest weight, or a tailwind past ten.

gonogo_density_altitude.description: Density altitude, ft, from pressure altitude and temperature (PHAK ch. 4).

gonogo_field_air.description: A field's pressure altitude and temperature, from its elevation and the reported altimeter and temperature, standard where not reported.

gonogo_soft_surface.description: Whether a runway's surface is grass, turf, dirt or gravel.

gonogo_runway_number.description: A runway end's number with its leading zero dropped: "09" to "9".

gonogo_runway_flown.description: The runway and end flown: the one picked where it is there, else the one the wind favours.

gonogo_runway_in_use.description: The runway end a pilot would take off from and land on: the one most nearly into the wind (AC 90-66C 11.5), else the most used runway's first end.

gonogo_picked_end.description: The end the pilot picked at a field, for a takeoff or a landing, or null.

kind.description: "takeoff" or anything else for a landing.

departure.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

gonogo_runway_checks.description: The runway check at each field taken off from or landed at, fields and runways by index: the runway, pressure and density altitude, wind along and across it, and the POH's distances against its length (14 CFR 91.103(b)). Empty without both tables.

metars.description: The briefing's METARs by field ident; null or missing for none.

airports.description: The briefing's airports by field ident, each with its runways.

pressure_alt_ft.description: Null where the field's elevation is not known (see unchecked).

reported.description: A METAR gave the temperature and altimeter.

unchecked.description: Why the field's distances were not worked out (distances then empty): its elevation not known.

caveats.description: What could not be had from the table: beyond its altitudes or temperatures, heavier than its heaviest weight, or a tailwind past ten.

unknown.description: No runway, or its length not known: whether it fits is not known (14 CFR 91.103(b)).

beyond.description: Read past the POH's table: the figures are its edge's, not the airplane's.

gonogo_balance.description: Weight and balance at takeoff and landing, against the profile's limits and envelope, with the problems found.

arm_in.description: null where the weight is zero.
null where the weight is zero.

gonogo_default_load.description: The load a profile starts with: its sample empty weight and arm, stations empty, the fuel given.

stations_lb.description: 170 lb at the first station, 0 at the others.

gonogo_in_envelope.description: Whether an arm and weight are within the CG envelope.

gonogo_pass_minutes.description: Minutes after departure the flight passes a point along the route, or null.

gonogo_tfr_when.description: A TFR's window against the pass time, widened by a margin.

gonogo_sua_when.description: A special-use area's times of use read for the pass. The host works the clocks out in the area's own time zone.

utc.description: [day 0-6 (0 Sunday), minute of the day], UTC.

local.description: The same in the area's own zone; null where not known.

wind_components.description: A wind's head- and crosswind on a heading: a tailwind negative, a crosswind from the right positive.

wind_steady_or_gust.description: The crosswind a wind is judged by, steady or in the gusts, whichever is more, unsigned.

runway_crosswind.description: A runway's wind's crosswind, steady or gust, whichever is more.

wind_calm.description: Whether a wind is calm, a speed of 0 (AIM 7-1-28); no speed is not calm.

runway_calm.description: Whether a runway's wind is a calm one: no head-, cross- or gust's crosswind.

runway_end_heading.description: A runway end's true heading, the table's or its number's magnetic heading turned true; null where it has neither.

runway_favoured_end.description: The end the wind favours, the planner's RunwayWind, or null.

runway_with_winds.description: Each runway's favoured end, the planner's RunwayWind or null.

wind_pick.description: The wind a field's runways are chosen by (lib/pattern WindPick, AC 90-66C 11.5), or null with no wind to go by.

nearby.description: The nearest report's wind, for a field that reports none (a TAF's, with forecast_at).

ident.description: The end as painted, "" where none is.

variable_kt.description: A variable wind's speed, there only for one.

in_use.description: There only where calm picked the runway in use.

from.description: Where the wind was reported when not at the field.

runway_end_key.description: A runway end's ident as a key: its number, trimmed and upper-cased.

faa_ids.description: The FAA identifiers an airport may go by in NASR (KSTL and STL).

pattern_side.description: The bearing, degrees true, from the runway to its pattern's side: right traffic to the right, else left (14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

traffic.description: "right" for right traffic; anything else, or none, is left (14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

compass_word.description: A bearing as one of the eight compass points.

pattern_entry.description: How to join the pattern for an end, coming on a course (AC 90-66C 11.3).

traffic.description: "right" for right traffic; anything else, or none, is left (14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

pattern_side.description: Whether it comes from the pattern's side.

traffic.description: "right" for right traffic; anything else, or none, is left (14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

pattern_altitude.description: A field's traffic pattern altitude: the published height, else 1,000 ft above the field (AC 90-66C).

altitude_ft.description: Feet MSL, whole; null with no elevation.

runway_ends_traffic.description: Each end's ident, true heading and traffic (right where its key is in `right`, else left, 14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

right.description: Ends' keys flown with right traffic.

runway_end_fit.description: Whether an end fits the airplane today for a takeoff or a landing: crosswind against the demonstrated, distance needed against the length with SAFO 19001's 15 per cent margin.

elevation_ft.description: Null where the field's elevation is not known: no distance is worked out (needed_ft null, unknown true).

close.description: Not short, but within SAFO 19001's 15 per cent.

unknown.description: The distance or the runway's length is not known, so whether it fits is not (14 CFR 91.103(b)); never read as fitting.

beyond.description: The distance was read past the POH's table (higher, hotter, heavier or more tailwind than it goes): its edge's figures.

traffic_pattern.description: The pattern to land on an end (lib/trafficPattern TrafficPattern), or null.

departure_pattern.description: The pattern to leave an end, toward a place where given, or null.

arrival_circuit.description: The arrival's circuit as the planner draws it, or null.

departure_circuit.description: The departure's circuit and the course out, or null.

flight_category.description: A field's flight category (AIM 7-1-7); with no visibility, LIFR only under a 500 ft ceiling and else null.

ceiling_unknown.description: The lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer was sent with no height (OVC///): the ceiling is not known, and only a visibility under a mile says the category (14 CFR 1.1).

taf_hour.description: An hour of a TAF from its groups in force (AC 00-45H).

before.description: The prevailing weather before the BECMG.

traffic_kind.description: An airplane's kind from its ADS-B emitter category (GDL 90 Table 11).

altitude_band.description: An altitude's band: low below 3,000 ft, mid to 10,000, high to 18,000, flight levels from 18,000 MSL (14 CFR 71.33(a)); null for none.

operator_of.description: The operator's ICAO three-letter designator from an airline's callsign, or null.

in_emergency.description: Whether an airplane is in an emergency: 7500, 7600 or 7700 set, or an emergency sent (AIM 6-2-2, 6-3-4, 6-4-2).

field_relation.description: Whether an airplane is around a field, inbound to it or departing it.

traffic_matches.description: Whether an airplane heard passes the traffic list's filter.

n_number.description: Whether text is a US registration, an N-number (14 CFR 47.15(b)).

registered_profile.description: The stock profile an airplane the FAA's registry names flies on, or null.

faa_words.description: The FAA's capitals in sentence case, its codes kept (AIM 3-2-1's "Class B"): one string from text, or each of texts as a list (a null row answers "").

texts.description: A long list's rows in one call; where given, text is not read.

title_case.description: The FAA's capitals in title case, from text, or each of texts as a list (a null row answers "").

place_name.description: A town's name as it is spelt ("McCook"), from text, or each of texts as a list (a null row answers "").

pirep_conditions.description: A PIREP's turbulence and icing in words, or null where it reports neither.

sua_altitudes.description: A special-use area's limits in words, STD a flight level (14 CFR 1.1).

mid_sentence.description: Written to go inside a sentence.

fuel_names.description: A field's fuel codes (NASR's) as names.

short_airspace_name.description: An airspace's name shortened for a card.

airspace_entry_rules.description: A Class B, C or D's entry, equipment and speed rules (14 CFR 91.117, 91.129-91.131, 91.215, 91.225), each with its cite, and whom to call. Any other one-letter class answers no rules.

class.description: One letter: B, C or D.

call.description: The frequency types to call: TWR for a Class D, APP then TWR otherwise.

frequency_line.description: A field's frequency as its card lists it: its name in words, its kind for the row's glyph, and the description in sentence case where that adds to the name.

frequency_of.description: The index of the first frequency (with a MHz) of the first of types the field lists, or null.

ctaf_of.description: The CTAF's index in frequencies (a CTAF, else a UNICOM that is the CTAF, else a UNICOM), or MULTICOM's 122.9 as a frequency where none is listed (AC 90-66C 9.6).

kneeboard_radio.description: A field's radio as the kneeboard lists it, [short name, MHz] in its order (the tower's before the CTAF's).

radial_of.description: The radial from a VOR a point is on, the course to the station and the distance, or null where the station has no magnetic variation.

fix_radial_distance.description: A point as a fix-radial-distance off the nearest station with a variation, "JOT 045° 12 nm" (AIM 5-1-6), or null.

morse.description: A navaid's ident in Morse code (AIM 1-1-3), the letters two spaces apart.

service_volume.description: A VOR's standard service volume by NASR's ALT_CODE (AIM 1-1-8 TBL 1-1-1), or null for a code not in the table.

navaid_hours.description: A navaid's hours as filed ("24" is "Continuous"), or null where none are filed.

hold_read.description: A hold read from the route's text ("VPBNG/090/30:270:R:1M:2T"), or null.

holds_read.description: Each comma-separated piece of text, trimmed, the empty left out, with its hold or null.

hold_write.description: A hold as the route's text writes it.

hold_length_read.description: A hold's length from its code ("2T", "10M"), or null.

hold_length_write.description: A hold's length as its code, from exactly one of whole turns or minutes.

hold_figures.description: A hold's lap and time held, in minutes, and its standard-rate turn radius (AIM 5-3-8); held_min is one lap where neither turns nor minutes is given.

procedures_read.description: Each piece of the route's procedures text with its pick as the web app reads it, or null, and whether it is one exactly as the planner takes it.

procedures_write.description: The route's procedures text from the picks (an empty transition or direct is none).

runways_read.description: Each piece of the route's runway picks ("KSTL:30R,KMSN:36") with its pick, or null.

altitude_lines.description: A fix's altitude restriction as the chart draws it: the kind of crossing, and each figure underlined (at or above) or overlined (at or below).

point_kind.description: What a route point typed is: a fix, the pilot's own point (fix-radial-distance), or null.

frd_read.description: A fix-radial-distance point read from text, or null.

bare_field.description: A field's FAA ident (the K of a US ICAO code left off).

same_field.description: Whether a and b name one field (KSTL and STL).

approach_guidance.description: How the approach is flown, by its CIFP id (ARINC 424-18 5.10): "localizer", "gps" or "other".

glidepath_ft.description: The glidepath's height, ft MSL, nm_out from the runway.

approach_attempts.description: The attempts at the approach in a track, as point indices.

approach_debrief.description: One attempt at an approach debriefed, or null.

approach_find.description: The approaches a track flew, each debriefed.

approach_transition.description: The transition's debrief, or null, from the vectors' debrief's figures.

approach_minimums.description: The findings held to the pilot's minimums (14 CFR 91.175(c), (e)).

approach_descent_fpm.description: The descent rate on the path, ft/min (the TPP's rate of descent table).

approach_rounded_fpm.description: A descent rate rounded as the lesson says it.

approach_category.description: The approach category (14 CFR 97.3) from VREF, or 1.3 VSO, or null with neither.

approach_minimums_kind.description: Which minimums an approach is flown to, by its name (AIM 5-4-5, FAA-H-8083-16B ch. 4).

approach_fix_name.description: A fix as said aloud: a runway's threshold ("RW08") by its runway.

approach_missed_words.description: The missed approach in the plate's words, or null.

approach_brief_frequencies.description: The frequencies an approach brief says.

approach_lesson_path.description: The lesson's line, the way in to the runway.

approach_path_between.description: The part of a path between two places on it.

approach_along_nm.description: How far along a path a place is, nm.

approach_brief.description: The approach briefed, item by item.

approach_coaching.description: The approach flown fix by fix, with a word at each.

approach_quiz.description: The approach asked back as a quiz; answer is the index of the right choice.

approach_profile.description: The approach seen from the side: its fixes along the way in and the path down from the final approach fix.

traffic_marks.description: Each airplane's label under it, its height against own ship's in hundreds as TCAS writes it, and whether it is within 1,000 ft of own ship's (14 CFR 91.159).

own_ship_hex.description: Which airplane heard is own ship's own transponder: its hex, or null.

closest_approach.description: When and how near an airplane comes to own ship, both carried on straight, within 10 minutes; null without both tracks and speeds.

above_ft.description: Its height above own ship's then, ft.

airborne_now.description: Whether a watched airplane is in the air: true, false, or null where not known.

alert_fires.description: Whether a watched airplane's alert goes off now: takes off, lands, or comes within limit_nm of a place.

inside.description: Near something: whether it is that near now; null for the others.

bearing_deg.description: True bearing from the place to the airplane.

glide_range.description: Still-air glide range, nm (1.5 nm per 1,000 ft, the C172S POH figure 3-1), or null on the ground or with no height.

glide_reaches.description: Whether a field distance_nm off is within still-air glide, arriving at pattern height (AC 90-66C's 1,000 ft).

underway.description: Whether own ship moves at flying speed.

plan_profile.description: The plan's altitudes along the route, from the nav log's rows: climbs, levels, descents at three to one.

dry_run.description: The planned flight flown on paper along the nav log's rows, by its procedures and holds, going missed when asked.

read_track.description: A GPX or KML track read: its points in time order, or the words for the pilot where it has none to use.

thin_track.description: At most `most` (4,000 where not given) of `points`, even steps through, the first and last kept; each point as it came.

strip_fuel.description: The fuel figure in the strip at the sheet's foot, web, iPhone and Android alike: the fuel required to the landing of hop `hop` (the first where the route has stops, the tanks filled at each; the whole route's where it has none), less what a flight under way has burnt, never below nothing; and the flights the tanks fall short on, a fuel margin under nothing (14 CFR 91.151, 91.167).

hop.description: The hop flown, 0 where left out.

burnt_gal.description: Burnt so far by a flight under way.

name.description: "C81 → KMSN"; "" for a route with no stops.

fuel_in_tanks.description: The fuel in the tanks at each point of the route and whether it is under the reserve: full at the departure, the start, taxi and takeoff allowance and each leg's burn taken from them after, filled again at each field landed at, as the planner checks each flight; null at a point past a leg whose burn is not known, until the next fill.

fuel_gal.description: The burn of the leg to it.

refuel.description: The tanks filled on landing there.

fuel_estimate.description: The figures from the airplane's book alone, before the nav log's: at cruise speed with no wind the minutes over the distance, the fuel at the cruise burn over them, and the fuel required, that with the start and taxi allowance (the Cessna 172S handbook's 1.4 gal, the planner's default) and 45 minutes' reserve at the cruise burn, the most the rules ask (14 CFR 91.151(a)(2), 91.167(a)(3)), so an estimate is never short. Null where the book gives no speed, or no burn for the fuel.

handbook_within.description: Whether an airplane's figure, typed in or read off its handbook's page, is within the bounds a light airplane's is believed within; outside them it is a misreading.

ceiling_visibility.description: A report's or a forecast group's ceiling (14 CFR 1.1: the lowest broken or overcast layer, or the vertical visibility into an obscuration) and its visibility in statute miles, from the groups a host's own reader found: metres converted as the engine's METAR reader converts them (9999 the AWC's 6+), to the hundredth; CAVOK 6 (WMO No. 306: 10 km or more). Each null where none is given.

cover.description: As a METAR codes it: FEW, SCT, BKN, OVC, VV; others count for no ceiling.

emitter_category.description: An ADS-B emitter category's name in DO-260B's words (GDL 90 Table 11): A1 to A7 and B1, B2; null for one not sent and for the rest.

squawk_meaning.description: What a squawk says, where it says more than a code: 7500 unlawful interference (AIM 6-3-4), 7600 two-way radio failure (AIM 6-4-2), 7700 an emergency (AIM 6-2-2); null for any other.

descent_altitude.description: About where a three-to-one descent (333 ft/nm, as the nav log descends) to pattern altitude has the airplane nm_out from the field, feet MSL to the hundred, no higher than the cruise; the cruise where no pattern altitude is known.

AirspaceBand.description: A band of the airspace over a point, as the planner's AirspaceBand: its floor and ceiling in feet MSL, its class, the volume's name for a B, C or D, 91.155(a)'s minimums by day and night (null in Class A), what it takes to go in, the equipment asked (91.215, 91.225) and the 91.117 speed limit.

ApproachAttempt.title: ApproachAttempt
ApproachAttempt.description: An attempt at an approach as indices into the track's points: where it crossed the final approach fix inbound, and the points it runs from and to.

ApproachDebrief.title: ApproachDebrief

faf_at.description: When the track crossed the final approach fix inbound, ms.

fit_nm.description: How far off the final it flew on average, nm.

glidepath_fit_ft.description: How far off the glidepath on average, ft, where there is one.

under_ft.description: Its furthest under its minimum on the way to it, ft (+ under).

crossings.description: The fixes passed in order (AIM 5-4-5), the missed approach's left out.

lowest_ft.description: The lowest after the final approach fix, before the missed approach point (14 CFR 91.175(c), (e)).

also_fits.description: Approaches whose final the track fitted as well, by name.

ApproachDebrief.description: One attempt at an approach debriefed (the web's ApproachDebrief, snake_case): off the course past full scale (AIM 1-1-9, 1-1-17), each fix's crossing (AIM 5-4-5), the lowest against the pilot's minimums (14 CFR 91.175(c), (e)).

minimums.description: The minimums' finding, put in again as the pilot types theirs; written only when true.

ApproachRunwayPath.title: ApproachRunwayPath
ApproachRunwayPath.description: The glidepath placed on its runway: its threshold, the height it crosses it at and its angle.

CircuitRunwayIn.title: CircuitRunwayIn

traffic.description: "right" for right traffic; anything else, or none, is left (14 CFR 91.126(b)(1)).

CircuitRunwayIn.description: A runway as the traffic pattern draws it: its ends' idents, true headings, traffic and thresholds.

kind.description: Anything else is read as not known.

said.description: Words naming one place or more, to be found.

EndHeadings.title: EndHeadings
EndHeadings.description: A runway's ends as [ident, true heading], either null.

FieldFrequency.title: FieldFrequency
FieldFrequency.description: A field's frequency as the planner sends it (NASR's type code, description and MHz).

type.description: NASR's code: TWR, GND, ATIS, CTAF, UNICOM...

GonogoAlternateData.title: GonogoAlternateData

required.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

good.description: False: under its alternate minimums; null: the pilot's to check; left out: says nothing.

GonogoAlternateData.description: The planner's /api/alternate answer, as much as the finding reads.

caveats.description: What could not be had from the table: beyond its altitudes or temperatures, heavier than its heaviest weight, or a tailwind past ten.

why.description: The rule or the reason it counts.

stop.description: Makes the flight unlawful as planned: high, whatever the points.

group.description: A self check's group; left out for the others.

finding.description: Its mark; null for a self check.

GonogoFlown.title: GonogoFlown
GonogoFlown.description: The runway and end flown, by index, or null.

GonogoInspections.title: GonogoInspections
GonogoInspections.description: The airplane's inspections and tests as its owner recorded them; null or a member left out says nothing.

GonogoItem.title: GonogoItem

tab.description: The planning panel's tab that shows it in full.

section.description: The section of that tab, by its title.

finding.description: "ok", "caution", "stop", "unknown" or "pending"; "" for a risk level not known (verdict::risk_finding).

GonogoItem.description: One tab's finding and where it is shown in full.

GonogoLine.title: GonogoLine
GonogoLine.description: What the findings come to, in a line over them.

stations_lb.description: Each station's load, in the loading's station order.

GonogoLoading.title: GonogoLoading

envelope.description: The CG envelope's points, [arm in, weight lb].

GonogoLoading.description: A profile's loading: limits, stations, fuel and envelope.

GonogoMetar.title: GonogoMetar
GonogoMetar.description: A field's METAR, as much as the rules read of it.

GonogoPicks.title: GonogoPicks

pattern.description: Field to end, as an object or [field, end] pairs.

takeoff.description: Field to end, as an object or [field, end] pairs.

GonogoPicks.description: The pilot's picked runway ends, landing (pattern) and takeoff.

GonogoRunwayWind.title: GonogoRunwayWind

in_use.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

GonogoRunwayWind.description: The planner's RunwayWind on a runway.

words.description: The words on the page the figure was read from.

num.description: The run of figures said as one number, as digits; left out where the word is no figure.

LessonFocus.title: LessonFocus
LessonFocus.description: What a lesson's step shows on the map: a fix ringed, a part of the procedure's line drawn over.

MetarWindIn.title: MetarWindIn
MetarWindIn.description: A METAR's wind; null, missing or empty for none.

NavLogRow.title: NavLogRow

kind.description: "fix" for a fix flown through rather than a field.

anyOf.description: The planner's Leg (/api/plan), as it comes.
The piece of the leg that arrives at this row, where a top of climb or descent cuts it.

NavLogRow.description: A nav log row, the web's NavLogRow: its place is the checkpoint's (cp), the top of climb's or descent's (point) or the airport's.

OwnShipFix.title: OwnShipFix
OwnShipFix.description: Own ship as the GPS has it.

ProcedureDrawing.title: ProcedureDrawing
ProcedureDrawing.description: A procedure as the planner draws it from the FAA's CIFP (/api/procedure's answer as it comes); only the members the engine reads.

RecentWindIn.title: RecentWindIn
RecentWindIn.description: The field's last wind, for a calm one; both members needed where it is not empty.

RouteHold.title: RouteHold
RouteHold.description: A pilot's hold as the route's address writes it ("VPBNG/090/30:270:R:1M:2T"): legs by minutes or by nm, length by turns or by minutes, the other of each pair null.

fix.description: The point held at: an airport, a fix, or the pilot's own point off one.

inbound.description: The inbound course to the fix, magnetic degrees, 0 to 359.

leg_min.description: The legs in minutes, or null where they are in nm.

leg_nm.description: The legs in nm, or null where they are in minutes.

turns.description: Laps to fly, or null where held by minutes.

minutes.description: Minutes to hold, or null where held by turns.

RouteHoldIn.title: RouteHoldIn
RouteHoldIn.description: A hold as the engine takes one: exactly one of leg_min and leg_nm, and (to write it) exactly one of whole turns and minutes.

Runway.title: Runway

closed.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

Runway.description: A runway as the planner sends one.

RunwayWindOut.title: RunwayWindOut

in_use.description: There only where calm picked the runway in use.

RunwayWindOut.description: The planner's RunwayWind: the end the wind favours and its components, whole numbers where the wind blew, 0 where calm; null for none.

ShortFieldTable.title: ShortFieldTable

tables.description: One per weight, each a grid of altitudes by temperatures.

ShortFieldTable.description: A POH's short-field takeoff or landing table: at least two altitudes and two temperatures, a grid of them for every weight.

TrafficPatternOut.title: TrafficPatternOut
TrafficPatternOut.description: lib/trafficPattern's TrafficPattern in snake_case, or null where it cannot be drawn.

TrafficPlane.title: TrafficPlane

seen_s.description: How old its position is, s.

TrafficPlane.description: An airplane as the traffic feed sends it: what the rules read of it.

VerdictInput.title: VerdictInput

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

vfr_not_recommended.description: AIM 7-1-5's "VFR flight not recommended", its reasons.

icing.description: Icing possible at an altitude flown, in a line (gonogo_icing).

hazards.description: SIGMETs and G-AIRMETs along the route, by name.

unchecked.description: Sources that did not answer, by name.

worst.description: The worst the forecast says along the route, in words.

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

in_force.description: TFRs on the route in force when the flight gets there.

near.description: The number of TFRs near the route not in force.

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

problem.description: No VFR altitude fits, in a line.

flown.description: The altitude flown as the FL chip says it.

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

margin_gal.description: The least the tanks hold over the fuel and its reserve; null where usable fuel is not known.

ifr.description: Under IFR the reserve is 14 CFR 91.167's, not 91.151's.

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

worked.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

beyond.description: Fields whose distances were read past the POH's table: a caution.

unchecked.description: Fields whose distances could not be held to the runway (its length or the field's elevation not known): unknown, never ok.

pending.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

worked.description: Read as JavaScript reads it: missing, null, false, 0 and "" are false.

VerdictInput.description: The web's VerdictInput: each tab's say, and the risk assessment's level and line (null while the briefing is awaited).

WordingStation.title: WordingStation
WordingStation.description: A VOR as the planner sends one; with no mag_var it gives no radials.

mag_var.description: The station's magnetic variation, degrees east.
